description: "Folk-Speech of Cumberland and Some Districts Adjacent" by Alexander Craig Gibson is a collection of short stories and rhymes written in the dialects of the West Border counties, likely during the late 19th century. The work showcases a rich tapestry of local vernacular and cultural nuances, intended to preserve the folk-speech of the region.
